parts.name: shell dome

physics.Basic_description: Large white glossy hemispherical shell forming the main protective body of the helmet.
physics.Functional_description: Primary impact protection structure enclosing the head cavity.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the large curved outer surface with a parallel jaw gripper, ensuring conformal contact to prevent slipping.
physics.reason: Helmet shells are thin-walled composite structures designed to enclose air and padding, not solid blocks of plastic.

parts.description: Large white glossy hemispherical shell forming the main protective body of the helmet.
parts.function: Primary impact protection structure enclosing the head cavity.

parts.name: chin trim

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey textured strip lining the lower edge of the helmet shell near the chin.
physics.Functional_description: Provides edge protection, sealing, and comfort against the wearer's neck/chin.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flexible to be a primary grasp point; would deform under grip force.
physics.reason: Rubber trim is typically a solid extruded or molded strip, even if thin.

parts.description: Dark grey textured strip lining the lower edge of the helmet shell near the chin.
parts.function: Provides edge protection, sealing, and comfort against the wearer's neck/chin.

parts.name: pivot stud left

physics.Basic_description: Small cyan cylindrical pin located at the visor hinge point on the left side.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a pivot point or fastener for the visor mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small to grasp reliably; would likely slip or damage the mechanism.
physics.reason: Pivot pins are solid metal cylinders to withstand shear forces.

parts.description: Small cyan cylindrical pin located at the visor hinge point on the left side.
parts.function: Acts as a pivot point or fastener for the visor mechanism.

parts.name: pivot stud right

physics.Basic_description: Small yellow cylindrical pin located at the visor hinge point on the right side.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a pivot point or fastener for the visor mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small to grasp reliably; would likely slip or damage the mechanism.
physics.reason: Pivot pins are solid metal cylinders to withstand shear forces.

parts.description: Small yellow cylindrical pin located at the visor hinge point on the right side.
parts.function: Acts as a pivot point or fastener for the visor mechanism.

parts.name: visor panel

physics.Basic_description: Large orange curved transparent/tinted panel covering the face opening.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the eyes and face from wind, debris, and impacts while allowing visibility.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the lower edge or side of the visor panel firmly but carefully to avoid scratching or cracking.
physics.reason: Visors are thin sheets of polycarbonate, effectively hollow shells relative to their bounding volume.

parts.description: Large orange curved transparent/tinted panel covering the face opening.
parts.function: Protects the eyes and face from wind, debris, and impacts while allowing visibility.

parts.name: visor trim

physics.Basic_description: Purple strip running along the top edge of the visor panel.
physics.Functional_description: Seals the gap between the visor and the helmet shell to reduce noise and wind.
physics.Grasped_description: Flexible and thin, not suitable for grasping; would deform easily.
physics.reason: Rubber seals are solid material strips, though thin.

parts.description: Purple strip running along the top edge of the visor panel.
parts.function: Seals the gap between the visor and the helmet shell to reduce noise and wind.

parts.name: visor pivot arms

physics.Basic_description: Cyan structural arms connecting the visor panel to the helmet shell pivots.
physics.Functional_description: Transfers motion from the pivot to the visor panel, allowing it to open and close.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped to manipulate the visor mechanism, but care needed to avoid breaking the plastic.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic arms are typically solid or have thick walls relative to their size to handle torque.

parts.description: Cyan structural arms connecting the visor panel to the helmet shell pivots.
parts.function: Transfers motion from the pivot to the visor panel, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: visor axle

physics.Basic_description: Magenta central axle component visible in the exploded view connecting the pivot arms.
physics.Functional_description: Central shaft allowing the visor assembly to rotate relative to the helmet.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, difficult to access for grasping without disassembly.
physics.reason: Axles are solid metal rods to transmit torque and support weight.

parts.description: Magenta central axle component visible in the exploded view connecting the pivot arms.
parts.function: Central shaft allowing the visor assembly to rotate relative to the helmet.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
